_help: Copy this file to data/agents/<first-last>.json for each real agent. Set status to 'published' only when name, BRN and photo are confirmed. 'sample' pages are private previews (noindex, not in the sitemap). Assign projects to an agent in data/assignments.json.
name: Sample Agent
title: Senior Property Consultant
bio: This is a design preview of an Al Basel agent profile. The real profile shows the agent's own introduction here: how long they have worked in Dubai property, the communities they know best and how they help buyers, sellers and tenants.

Below the introduction, visitors see the agent's specialties, languages and communities, followed by every property and project assigned to them. Each enquiry from this page is saved to the Al Basel leads sheet with the agent's name, and WhatsApp opens directly with the agent.
